temporaryPasswordNotice: Your password is temporary. Choose a new password to continue.
displayNameHint: Shown in the header, on exams you sign and in the audit log.
cylinderHint: Unsigned cylinder entries in refraction get this sign.
myLanguageHint: The language of menus and messages, for you only. What is typed in a chart is never translated.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
practiceLead: Used on printed reports and spectacle / contact lens prescriptions.
adminReadyNext: Fill in your practice details, then add users in Users.
practiceNameHint: Printed at the top of reports and prescriptions.
addressHint: One line, e.g. "100 Main Street, Anytown, ST 00000".
codeSetHint: Existing impression items and history entries keep the codes they have; only codes added from now on use the new set.
icd11Citation: {citation}. Licence: {licence}. Release {release}, English, as published by WHO.
usSuggestionsHint: Suggests visit and test codes to copy into your billing system. OpenVision does not create bills. Off: the Codes section (key 0) is not offered and no codes print on the report. Nothing already saved is deleted; switching it back on shows it again.
defaultLanguageHint: For everyone who has not chosen a language in My settings, and on the sign-in page. What is typed in a chart is never translated.
usersLead: One account per person; never share a sign-in. Deactivated users cannot sign in and are signed out at once. Any admin can reset any password (emergency access); if no admin can sign in, run {command} on the server.
usersDemoOpen: The demo accounts {names} still use the public demo password. Deactivate them or reset their passwords before real use.
mustChangeAtFirstSignIn: They must change it at first sign-in.
auditLead: Sign-ins, account and settings changes, chart and exam views, signing and lock events. Read-only: entries can never be edited or deleted.
normalsLead: What the Normal buttons and the {shorthand} shorthand write into an exam, per section. Leave a box blank to have Normal skip that field. Only you use these values.
normalsResetAllConfirm: Replace ALL your normal values with the starter values?
normalsResetAllHint: Start over: every section goes back to the starter values.
normalsResetAll: Reset all sections to starter values
visitTypesLead: The choices offered when starting a visit. Hidden types stay on past visits but are no longer offered. Renaming does not change past visits.
quickPicksLead: The one-tap findings in the exam's Quick picks panel. Each pick writes its text into one row, for the right eye, the left eye or both. The mode decides what happens to text already in the field.
qpTextHint: Leave empty with "Replace" to make a "clear field" pick.
qpResetConfirm: Replace this whole list with the starter list? Your own picks here will be removed.
qpDragHint: Drag a row by its handle, or use the arrow buttons, to change the order.
codeSetsLead: Diagnosis codes are not part of OpenVision. Download the code set your practice uses: the server fetches the official file, checks that it is exactly the expected release and keeps it on this computer. Diagnoses already saved keep their codes and text whatever you do here.
codeSetsValidFrom: Release {release}, for dates of service from {date}.
codeSetsOlder: An older release is loaded. Download release {release} to update.
codeSetsDownloading: Downloading… this takes a few seconds.
codeSetsRemoveConfirm: Remove the {set} codes from this computer? Diagnoses already saved keep their codes and text.
codeSetsRemoveInUse: In use by the practice, so it cannot be removed. Choose another code set in Practice first.
codeSetsFailed: That did not work (the server answered {status}).
codeSetsNoConnection: No answer from the OpenVision server. Check the connection.
codeSetsOffline: No internet on this computer? Download {link} on another computer and import it here unchanged: the zip, or the text file {entry} inside it.
codeSetsNotDownloadedPractice: Not downloaded yet: diagnosis codes cannot be searched or saved until it is.
codeSetsLangLead: WHO publishes ICD-11 with official titles in other languages. Download the ones your staff use: the code finder then searches and shows WHO's titles in each person's interface language, and diagnoses are saved with that title. OpenVision never translates a title itself; codes WHO has not translated show in English.
codeSetsLangEnglish: English: always used. It comes with the ICD-11 code set above, and the findings engine searches it.
codeSetsLangLater: Available for later: OpenVision has no interface in this language yet.
codeSetsLangPrerelease: WHO marks this translation as a pre-release.
codeSetsLangTitlesOnly: WHO's file in this language has titles only.
codeSetsLangRemoveConfirm: Remove WHO's {language} titles from this computer? Diagnoses already saved keep their titles.
codeSetsLangOffline: Offline: download {link} on another computer and import it here unchanged.
codeSetsLangNoHindi: WHO publishes no Hindi ICD-11 file, so Hindi users see the English titles.
